name: overfull
description: Skills, a guard and an MCP server for LaTeX papers and theses: add verified citations, fix the build, fit page limits, make the PDF accessible. Needs the overfull CLI on PATH.

hooks.command: if command -v overfull >/dev/null 2>&1; then overfull guard --hook claude; elif [ -f overfull.yml ] && grep -qi '\.bib'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"overfull is not on PATH, so the .bib guard did not run. Add references with `make cite ARGS=...` (Docker) or install overfull."}'; fi
